notes: Defaults remain MongoDB 7.0 and PyMongo 4.9; axes stay independent.
maxWireVersion remains 20; Engine SPI v2, search-v1 and SQLite storage format unchanged.
The 30 ordinary-suite skips are optional real suites and inherited base suites; the mandatory real differential has zero skips.
The global suites emit one unraisable event-loop GC warning; it is retained in their logs.
Parallel global suites used separate TMPDIRs to prevent interference between existing spill-file assertions.
Closure documentation and evidence are excluded from the input fingerprint and do not alter built distributions.
